name: Required Reason APIs and privacy manifest
plain: Apple requires apps to declare why they use 5 fingerprint-prone API groups, in a privacy manifest file.
meaning: Apps must list approved reasons per group in PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy or App Store Connect rejects the upload. Reasons limit use; fingerprinting is banned even with consent.

android.api_surface: No equivalent; Play data safety form is looser
android.note: Play uses the Data safety section and policy reviews, not per-API reasons

ios.api_surface: 5 categories (file timestamp, boot time, disk space, active keyboards, user defaults) and 17 reason codes; enforced 2024-05-01

limits.headline: Can only use five fingerprint prone phone details with an approved reason on iPhone
limits.user_action: Nothing. Apple checks the reasons when the developer uploads the app
can: Use file times, boot time, disk space, active keyboards and saved settings, with a listed reason
List the reasons in the privacy manifest file
Pass review when reasons match how the app works
cannot: Use these details to fingerprint you, even with consent
Be uploaded to the App Store with missing reasons
Apply on Android; Play uses Data safety and reviews instead
limits.differs: iPhone only (iOS 17 and later). Android has no required reason list.

story.what_it_is: The rule that iOS apps must declare why they use certain fingerprint prone APIs, in a privacy file.

marketing.name: Required reason API
marketing.pitch: Apps must list approved reasons for using certain APIs in the privacy manifest.

story.for_you: You do not see it. It is a rule that makes apps declare why they check things like how much disk space you have.
story.for_makers: Apps must list approved reasons per group in PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy, or App Store Connect rejects the upload. Reasons limit use, and fingerprinting is never an approved reason.

use_cases.example: A game states that it reads free space only to decide which art to download.
An ad SDK drops a check of boot time to avoid a rejection.
An analytics SDK says it uses uptime only for app speed numbers.
A photo app states it reads file dates only to sort a gallery.
Apple reviewers compare declared reasons with real use.
A developer runs the privacy report in Xcode to find missing reasons.

story.android_note: Android has no equal. Policy and API limits handle it.
story.ios_note: Enforced when the build is uploaded.

technical_bounds: Third-party SDKs need their own manifests

history.change: Privacy manifests and Required Reason APIs announced at WWDC
Missing reasons cause App Store rejection from 2024-05-01
